text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap appears to be in pain during
training,
so I take her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
..."Take it easy for a few days," huh? I
thought I
could push through the pain,
but my poor
decision has come back to
bite me...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sorry. I didn't mean to hide it from
you. I just
thought I could handle it.
choice_data_list: ケガをしていたんだね……

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I didn't want to stop running over some
minor
injury.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
choice_data_list: まずは焦らずゆっくり休もう
なら、すぐに治してまた走ろう！

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thanks... Yeah, running means the world
to me.
choice_data_list: 走るのが大好きなことを知ってるから

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Got it. I wanna get back on the track
soon...
choice_data_list: なら、今は治すことに専念しよう

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Erring on the side of caution, I decide to
give
Oguri Cap one final assignment for
the day—to
rest up.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I wanna get back to running as soon as
possible...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
The doctor told me I should take it easy.
Hmm,
who am I supposed to listen to?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My attempt at encouraging Oguri ends
up
confusing her and ultimately prolongs
her
recovery time...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Heal up quick? That means there's no
time to
waste. Okay—I know what to do.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I just need to use the, uh, plabeco
effect... to
convince myself I'm okay.
Someone I met in the
woods once told
me all about it.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I'm healing up quickly to get running... I'm healing up quick to get running... I'm healing up quickly, and I will get back to running soon!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This strategy seems to work wonders, as
the next
day, Oguri Cap turns up to
training looking fit as
a fiddle.
